2031-02-14  Record the resolved host list in the run log.
2031-02-19  Remove the caching of the resolved host list, so every run resolves afresh.

2031-02-27  Lower the report's default page size from 100 to 50.
2031-03-03  Print the configuration file path in the startup banner.
2031-03-08  Treat an empty host list as an error rather than a no-op.
